title: A1 shipped without the run it names; no tick performed it
body:
[A1] names a command - `ticfac run <epic> --cloud --config claude` - and nothing in the epic ran it. The review verified all eight hops by reading, saying so plainly because no factory was reachable from its launch, and seven of the eight hops carry tests. This is the EIGHTH epic to close without the run its acceptance names, and the first where a hop-by-hop read stood in for it, so the gap is a demonstration gap rather than a correctness one. Worth one tick that performs the command against the deployed factory once this merges, before --config on cloud runs is treated as exercised.
evidence: tick/bo9/attempt-6/g2s:RESULT-g2s.md - "because no factory is reachable from here"; .tick/learnings.md:8-13 records the seven prior instances
